points.title: Iteration
points.must: Repeating a group of steps (loop body); in a flowchart a flow line goes back, controlled by a decision.

points.title: Three kinds of loop
points.must: Count-controlled (FOR, fixed number), pre-condition (WHILE, tested before, 0+ times), post-condition (REPEAT…UNTIL, tested after, at least once) — with pseudocode.

points.title: Pre- vs post-condition flowcharts
points.must: Both loop shapes drawn: decision before the body vs after the body, arrows back.

points.title: Counting
points.must: count ← 0 before the loop, count ← count + 1 for each event, with an example.

points.title: Totalling
points.must: total ← 0 before the loop, total ← total + value, with an example.

points.title: Worked example: canteen
points.must: Sales until 0 entered; count, total and average; check count > 0 to avoid division by zero.

points.title: Loop mistakes
points.must: Initialising inside the loop, counter never changed (infinite loop), off-by-one, FOR when the number is unknown.

points.title: Validation
points.must: Automatic check that input is reasonable / obeys rules before it is accepted; it cannot prove data correct.

points.title: Validation checks as conditions
points.must: Range, presence, length, format, type (and lookup) checks, each with its decision.

points.title: Validation loop flowchart
points.must: Drawn: INPUT → decision → No: error message and back to INPUT → Yes: continue.

points.title: Validation vs verification
points.must: Validation = rules applied by the computer; verification = data copied accurately (double entry, visual check).

points.title: Trace table
points.must: One column per variable; filled row by row by hand to find the output and logic errors; steps to trace.

points.title: Flowchart ↔ pseudocode
points.must: IF…ENDIF, WHILE, REPEAT…UNTIL and FOR matched to their flowchart shapes; one conversion example.

points.title: Converting pseudocode to a flowchart
points.must: The PIN example (REPEAT…UNTIL then IF) converted step by step.
